newsitem.title: USA: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Spreads are the play of the day.
newsitem.headline: U.S. OPTIONS FOCUS/Spreads are the play of the day.

text.p: Individual equity options trading increased to more normal levels after the holidays, but some traders said activity remained quiet.
"It's still quiet considering the market volatility," Andrew Schwarz, senior partner at AGS Specialist Partners, said. "We've definitely seen a pickup, but not everybody is back to work yet."
The market was closed Wednesday for New Year's Day.
Schwarz said despite the larger crowd on the trading floor, only two equity options had significant turnover and both were active on strategies involving spreads.
A spread in DuPont Co January 75 calls and April 75 calls traded 5,120 as an investor rolled a position out.
DuPont shares were unchanged at 94-1/8. The January 75 calls traded at 19-1/2 and the April 75 calls traded at 2-1/4.

A sizable spread also crossed in Chase Manhattan Corp put options, where the January 90 put traded about 2,200 contracts and the March 90 put traded about 2,130. Of that volume, 2,093 contracts in each crossed as a spread.
Chase shares were down 2-1/8 at 86-5/8, helping to drive the put prices higher. The January 90 put rose 1-3/8 to four and the March 90 put gained 1-1/8 to 5-3/4.
The Chase January 85 call traded about 4,050 contracts, falling 1-3/8 to 3-1/2.
The other high-volume situation was also from spread transactions, this one in PepsiCo Inc options on Chicago Board Options Exchange.
The PepsiCo January 30 call traded more than 10,200 contracts and the July 30 call traded about 10,200. Of that volume, 10,120 contracts in each option crossed as spreads done in two blocks of 5,060.
A trader at CBOE said the investor bought back the January 30 calls for 1/2 a point and sold the July 30 calls for 2-1/2 points, earning a 2-point credit.
"They picked up two points by rolling over," said Michael Schwartz, managing director at Oppenheimer & Co. He added the transaction could have been to protect a stock position.
PepsiCo shares were up 1/4 at 29-1/2 in afternoon trading Thursday. Consolidated volume was 3.63 million shares.
